TreeItem.title: TreeItem
TreeItem.description: A single entry in a repository tree from `GET /projects/:id/repository/tree`.

mode.description: Git file mode (e.g., "100644" for regular file).

FileContent.title: FileContent
FileContent.description:
File content from `GET /projects/:id/repository/files/:path`.

Note: The `content` field is Base64 encoded.

last_commit_id.description: Last commit ID that modified this file.

ref.description: Git ref (branch/tag) the file was retrieved from.

MergeRequest.title: MergeRequest
MergeRequest.description: Merge request summary from list/get endpoints.

closed_at.description: Close timestamp (ISO 8601, if closed without merge).

draft.description: Whether this is a draft MR.

iid.description: Project-scoped internal ID (use this for API calls).

merge_when_pipeline_succeeds.description: Whether to merge when pipeline succeeds.

User.title: User
User.description: A GitLab user summary (common across many responses).

avatar_url.description: URL to the user's avatar image.

web_url.description: HTML URL to the user's profile.

Commit.title: Commit
Commit.description: A commit in a merge request.

Diff.description: A file diff in a merge request.

new_file.description: Whether this is a new file.

iid.description: Project-scoped internal ID (use this for API calls).

moved_to_id.description: ID of issue this was moved to.

confidential.description: Whether this is a confidential note.

internal.description: Whether this is an internal note.

system.description: Whether this is a system-generated note.

release.description: Associated release info (if this is a release tag).

TagCommit.description: Commit info embedded in a tag.

TagRelease.description: Brief release info embedded in a tag.

tag_name.description: Tag name associated with the release.
Tag name associated with the release.

upcoming_release.description: Whether this is an upcoming release.

ReleaseCommit.description: Commit info embedded in a release.

ReleaseLink.description: A custom asset link in a release.

external.description: Whether this is an external link.

ReleaseSource.description: A source archive for a release.

avatar_url.description: URL to the project's avatar image.
URL to the namespace's avatar image.
